supersedes.rule: D263, fixed by the leader before any result: after the mask study ends, score adapter-v2 through select_adapter's exact path on the same 400-row selection sample. Retain v2 as the adopted reader, per the pre-registered result, unless v2 scores more than 3 points below swa-last-5's 93.25 % there; in that case adopt swa-last-5 for its domain coverage.

reason: D266, leader, open for veto: D264 retained v2 by a tie-break on exact match. The mask study then measured what that tie-break never looked at: on 84 out-of-scope validation sentences v2 made a rule from 27, 16 naming a real bay, a misreading the checker cannot catch; v3 from 4.
